scripts.build:sidecar:mac: mkdir -p build/sidecar/darwin-arm64 && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -o build/sidecar/darwin-arm64/workspace-sidecar ./cmd/workspace-sidecar
scripts.build:sidecar:win: mkdir -p build/sidecar/win32-x64 && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o build/sidecar/win32-x64/workspace-sidecar.exe ./cmd/workspace-sidecar
scripts.build:sidecars: npm run build:sidecar:mac && npm run build:sidecar:win
